items.title: Correct

items.title: Introduce yourself
items.text: Write 5 sentences to introduce yourself (name, age, town, school, class).
items.solution: My name is … I am … years old. I live in … I study at … I am in the first year.

items.title: Formal or informal
items.text:

items.solution: Formal: Good morning, sir; How do you do? ; Informal: Hi!, Hey!, Hello.

items.title: Complete the dialogue
items.text:
Complete:
Ali: Hello, Fatima! How ___ you?
Fatima: I'm fine, ___ you. And you?
Ali: I'm ___, thanks.
items.solution: are – thank – fine / good / OK

items.title: Plural
items.text: Put in the plural: This is a pen. – That is a chair.
items.solution: These are pens. – Those are chairs.

items.title: Dialogue
items.text: Put in order: a) See you tomorrow, Sidi. b) Bye, Ahmed! c) It's late. I must go home.
items.solution: c – a – b

items.text: Write in figures: eleven – nineteen – forty-two – twenty-eight.

items.title: Complete

What are you doing now?

items.title: Proposal 18 — Term 3 exam
items.text:
Exercise 1 : Opposites
Give the opposite: big – long – new – heavy.

Exercise 2 : My day
Write 5 sentences about your daily routine.

Exercise 3 : Present continuous
Complete: I ___ (read) now. They ___ (play) football. She ___ (write) a letter.
items.solution:
Exercise 1
small – short – old – light

Exercise 2
I get up at six. I pray. I have breakfast. I go to school at half past seven. I do my homework in the evening.

Exercise 3
am reading – are playing – is writing

items.title: Proposal 19 — Term 3 exam
items.text:
Exercise 1 : Describe
Describe your school bag (size, color, quality).

Exercise 2 : Can / can't
Write true sentences with can or can't: swim – ride a bike – speak French.

Exercise 3 : Negative
Make negative: He is sleeping. – We are watching TV.
items.solution:
Exercise 1
My bag is big and blue. It is new and strong.

Exercise 2
I can swim. I can't ride a bike. I can speak French. (answers may vary)

Exercise 3
He isn't sleeping. – We aren't watching TV.
